posts.name: Nathan Lambert
posts.text: 我关于开放模型和网络风险的观点是否有误？我不这么认为。人工智能领域的研究者们关注的是错误的方向——他们关注的是哪种类型的模型会造成危害，而不是如何维护网络安全的平衡，谁会实施危害行为，以及他们如何使用新的工具来达成目的。

posts.text: Open models will be used for cyber attacks, just like closed models have been. At the same time, open models aren’t the super high leverage tool magically increasing cyber crime by 100x — those bottlenecks lay elsewhere.
posts.quoted: Was I wrong about open models & cyber risks? I don't think so. The AI community is focusing on the wrong lens - which type of model is causing harm - rather than how cybersecurity maintains an equilibrium, who enacts harm, and how they use new tools. https:// interconnects.ai/p/was-i-wrong- about-open-models-and …

posts.author: natolambert
posts.name: Nathan Lambert
posts.text: In fact, open models could be what holds the ecosystem together, we need more evidence and time.
